item.name: Create a signing. This endpoint allows for the creation of a new signing, including the ability to add a webhook callback URL.

request.name: Create a signing. This endpoint allows for the creation of a new signing, including the ability to add a webhook callback URL.

description.content:
Sample request:
            
    POST /signings
            
Request Body:
            
```json
{
    "Id": "example-guid-1",
    "Name": "Test Layout",
    "AccountId": "example-guid-2",
    "StatusId": 1,
    "IsOrdered": false,
    "DateCreated": "2023-04-20T02:59:00Z",
    "LastModified": "2023-04-21T02:59:00Z",
    "ExpirationDate": "2023-04-26T02:59:00Z",
    "IdPosition": 1,
    "ReminderDay": 5,
    "ReminderHour": 2,
    "TransactionId": "example-guid-3",
    "TechnologyProvider": "TechProviderName",
    "CallbackUrl": "https://yourcallbackurl.com",
    "Files": ["File1", "File2"],
    "FilesWithStrikeoutsDisabled": ["FileName1", "FileName2"]
}
```
            
Note: Replace "example-guid-1", "example-guid-2", etc., with actual GUID values and "File1", "File2" with your file objects.
